title: Cutout plugin settings (schemaVersion 1)
description: Envelope `data` of the project's one settings document, plugins/cutout-animation/settings/project.json (plugin 1.9.0). Absent document = the defaults. Semantics in docs/contract.md.

atlas.description: Pack every PNG the exported rigs draw into atlas pages (fewer files, one texture per page). Pixels never change.

maxPageSize.description: Largest page edge in pixels (default 2048); bigger pictures stay separate files.

padding.description: Duplicated edge pixels around every picture (default 2), so filtering never reaches a neighbour.

trim.description: Leave out transparent borders of pictures drawn at their own size (default true; a 1 px transparent ring is kept).
